ns2:section.sectionText: Title:Racial Inequality in the US This course will explore racial stratification in the United States with particular attention to patterns of inequality that persist across various social instituations affecting quality of life for racial/ethnic minorities. Topics to be discussed include: residential segregation, housing access, environmental racism, health disparities, educational inequalities, and discrimination in hiring/labor relations. While the focus will be on structural patterns of inequality, readings will aslo address the day-to-day practices that produce and sustain these disparities.
